versions.changelog:
Initial release: Generate videos using Google Cloud Vertex AI (Veo) via Application Default Credentials.

- Supports text-to-video and image-to-video generation from prompt files.
- Uses the `gcloud` CLI and `curl` for API access and authentication.
- Allows custom project, location, model, resolution, aspect ratio, duration, and audio settings.
- Requires Google Cloud SDK and `curl` to be installed.
- Simple CLI workflow for prompt handling and video generation.
